insights: The Time To First Byte (TTFB) for all pages is relatively low, indicating that the server is responding quickly.
The First Contentful Paint (FCP) for all pages is reasonable, suggesting that the initial view of the page is loading quickly.
The duration of the tests for all pages is within an acceptable range, indicating that the pages are loading efficiently.
It is crucial to investigate the reason for the "How It Works" page failing the test and optimize it for better performance.
